items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Hamilton, you know, used to play trumpet with Frankie Fairfax... He had two great clarinet players in the band. He had Jimmy Hamilton and Russell Procope.

ctx.x: You got any more trumpet players down there you want to -- ?

I think Taft came from Philadelphia, too, I think. I think he was in that band of Frankie Fairfax. In fact, the trumpet section, I think Taft was there and I think Dizzy was there. And, you know, Jimmy Hamilton, you know, used to play trumpet with Frankie Fairfax, the great clarinetist that was with Ellington, he played trumpet with Frankie Fairfax.
Frankie Fairfax had a band, huh?
